name: Fantastic Four (wife)
notes: Rebuilt from the stock precon (the Walls build is dropped).

Commander: Crystal, Inhuman Princess. Every noncreature spell deals damage to each opponent equal to its color count, so 2- and 3-color spells are the backbone (the Charms package). Invisible Woman, her other pick, is in the 99, and the build still works with her as commander: swap the two.

Engine: Reed Richards draws whenever tokens enter (Namor, Storm-Kiln and Alicia Treasures, Invisible Woman Walls, The Fantastic Four Wall). Valeria discounts spells and draws; Mister Fantastic, Whirlwind, Archmage and First Family refill.

Cuts from the stock precon (25): Galactus, Devourer of Worlds, Silver Surfer, Galactus's Herald, Dragon Man, Reformed Robot, Willie Lumpkin, Postman, Power Pack, Collective Effort, Cut a Deal, Deep Analysis, Genesis Ultimatum, Into the Time Vortex, Nova Flame, Promise of Loyalty, Quantum Misalignment, Recurring Insight, Terramorph, Tragic Arrogance, Seize the Day, Mirage Mirror, Negative Zone Portal, The Fantasticar, Mind's Dilation, Monologue Tax, Path of Discovery, Plains, Forest.
Bracket 2 check: no Game Changers, no extra turns, no mass land destruction. Jeskai Ascendancy with Crystal makes 1-mana spells nearly free, but it is not an infinite combo.
Adds marked planned: confirm she has a free copy (Charms, Electrolyze, the Commands and the token creatures may need buying; all are cheap). Swan Song stays out (no spare).

Nov 10, 2026: 10 swaps. Thor package (Guardian of Midgard, Asgard's Avenger, God of Thunder), Human Torch Johnny Storm and Hawkeye (Kate Bishop) for burn; protection package for Crystal (Swiftfoot Boots, Flawless Maneuver, Snakeskin Veil, Tyvar's Stand, Tamiyo's Safekeeping). Deflecting Swat skipped on price. The Mighty Thor (Jane) and Thor Odinson considered and left out. B3 variant now cuts Negate, Electrolyze and Expressive Iteration, since Opt and Bovine Intervention are gone.

Nov 13, 2026: speed package from a 3,000-game sim using exact card text from the mtg-data repo. Crystal on turn 3 went from 47% to 64% (avg turn 4.1 to 3.75). Six tapped/fetch lands swapped for spare pain lands; Council of Reeds, Third Path Iconoclast, Monastery Mentor, Chromatic Lantern and Bant Charm swapped for 1-2 mana ramp (Birds, Utopia Sprawl, Rampant Growth, Nature's Lore, Fellwar Stone; about $9.40). Invisible Woman kept by choice. Rule for this deck: ramp costs 1-2 mana (Cultivate the one 3-mana exception); don't add more ramp than this.

Nov 20, 2026: Storm, Windrider ({1}{G}{W}{W}, Marvel Super Heroes uncommon, owned) in for Ultimate Nullification (5 mana, sacrifices her own legend and exiles her own board). Cleansing Nova stays as the one wipe; Flame On! is the next cut if she wants a second. The '+ Storm' variant is dropped: it used Storm, Force of Nature by mistake.
source: Stock precon + F4 Jumpstart packet + 25 swaps, Nov 9, 2026
